Name: Aki's Gojo Satoru Portraits
Author: AkiNoKage
Description:
This portrait mod has 5 sets of portraits that are toggleable. I'd recommend using  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily swap between them. There are 3 for normal portraits (Blindfold, No Blindfold, and Sunglasses) and 2 for beach portraits (Normal and Sunglasses).

There is an additional toggle for Beach Jacket, though there is no matching portraits yet. Those will be added alongside seasonal.

The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21209]Gojo Satoru NPC mod[/url] is made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/96123368]cursedcure[/url]. These are just my recreation of the portraits.
